music_prompt: Warm minimal electronic background for a software product demo about cameras and video calls. Soft analog synth pads, a gentle plucked arpeggio with a little shimmer, light airy percussion and a soft kick, steady 100 BPM, optimistic and clean, modern, no vocals, no big drops, even energy throughout, ends softly.
text:
Your phone has a better camera than your laptop. Lens turns it into a webcam for your PC.

Open Lens on the phone, and the PC finds it by itself. Over Wi-Fi, or USB.

In Zoom, Teams, OBS or Discord, just pick the camera called Lens.

Blur the background with one click.

Turn on auto-frame, and the shot follows your face.

Need a minute? Hit pause, and everyone sees, be right back.

Up to 4K at sixty frames per second. No ads, no watermark, no pro version.

Lens. Free, on GitHub.
